documents.title: Critical edition introduction
documents.text:
Critical edition introduction — Codex Aldane (fictional).
In this document "CA-MS" means Codex Aldane. Codex AB reports radiocarbon median date (CE) of 1135 year for FY2024. Codex Aldane reports approximately quire count of 36 for FY2024. Codex Aldane reports lacunae share of 33.3% for FY2024. Codex Aldane reports recorded variant readings of 1426 for FY2025 on a reported basis. For Codex Aldane, the place of origin is: copied in the northern scriptorium.
